gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.156: Some sights are too much for the unready. Near something truly unnatural your heart starts to pound and the edges of your sight go cold: get out of its sight before you faint. The more of the other side you have lived through, the steadier you stand, and the more you start to see. Its wounds can follow you into sleep, too.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.uneasy.1: I don't like this. I don't like this at all.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.uneasy.3: That's not natural. That's not right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.withdraw.0: No. No, I can't. I'm sorry!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.withdraw.2: Fall back! Get away from it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.woke.0: Wh... what happened? Is it gone?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.woke.1: I saw it. I saw its face...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.woke.2: Don't tell anyone I went down like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.overcome.woke.3: My head... it was looking right at me.
There you are, %1$s. You went white and just dropped. Whatever you saw, it's gone now.
Easy, easy. Breathe. You're safe, I've got you.
Oh, thank goodness. You looked at something and your eyes rolled right back.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.overcome.plain: Up you get, %1$s. You keeled over like you'd seen a ghost.
You went down hard. Saw something you shouldn't have, I'd say.
On your feet, %1$s. Fainting like a maid at the first sight of the dark.
Get up. If it had wanted you, you'd be dead.
Up. And next time, look away.
%1$s, you fainted. Something unholy was out there and you went down the moment you saw it. Here, drink, it'll steady you.
You fainted dead away, love. It happens to anyone who sees one of those things up close. Have a sip of this.
You saw something from the other side and it was too much. Drink. The shaking passes, I promise.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.overcome.plain: You fainted, %1$s. Saw something unnatural and dropped. Drink this.
That thing was too much for you, that's all. Have some water and get your feet under you.
You went out cold when it showed itself. You'll stand it better next time. Here.
You fainted at the sight of it, %1$s. Drink this and stop shaking.
Dropped like a stone the moment it looked at you. Here. Don't make me carry you.
Seen one of those before? No, I can tell. Drink, and keep your eyes off it next time.
